story_meaning_room.name: Layer E Story Meaning Room
story_meaning_room.summary: The replacement should not be another soft concept. It should start from a one-second public contradiction and then reveal tenderness through receipts.
story_meaning_room.human_story_requirement: Daily married-life phrase or behavior that looks funny first and reveals being known second.
story_meaning_room.emotional_obstacle_requirement: A small mismatch between what one partner says and what the moment actually needs.
story_meaning_room.proof_requirement: At least three concrete receipts before any thesis.
story_meaning_room.active_zuv_requirement: Zuv must translate, adjust, wait, find, hold, or deadpan-react. He cannot be passive furniture or saintly rescuer.

contrarian_room.name: Contrarian Repair Room
rejections: No food-denial lane after creator rejection.
No repeated chaos/calm wording without a new physical receipt.
No private setup that needs caption explanation.

selectable_routes.title: Aachu Dictionary
selectable_routes.plain_concept: Things she says vs what she actually means, staged as tiny domestic translations.
selectable_routes.emotional_obstacle: Her words and her needs do not always arrive in the same language.
selectable_routes.proof_engine: `jaldi`, `main kar lungi`, `kuch nahi hua`, `theek hai` each gets one visible contradiction.
selectable_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv reads the scene and responds to the real need, not the literal sentence.

selectable_routes.title: Ready Means The Search Has Started
selectable_routes.plain_concept: She says she is ready at the door, then the one-earring/key/lip-balm search begins.
selectable_routes.public_doorway: Ready is not a status. Ready is a process.
selectable_routes.emotional_obstacle: The leaving moment creates time pressure, but the relationship stays playful instead of blaming.
selectable_routes.proof_engine: Door half-open, one earring missing, phone flashlight under bed, Zuv holding keys and finding the tiny object.
selectable_routes.zuv_active_role: He joins the search like this is part of leaving, not a failure.
selectable_routes.payoff: Love waits for the whole person, not just the schedule.

internal_repair_or_reject_routes.title: House Weather System
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.plain_concept: AC, fan, blanket, window, and body temperature become a domestic climate negotiation.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.public_doorway: Some couples don't fight. They update the house weather.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.emotional_obstacle: Two comfort systems share one room.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.proof_engine: Fan remote, blanket edge, AC temperature, window crack, Zuv shifting the airflow instead of arguing.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.zuv_active_role: He physically adjusts the room so both can exist in it.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.payoff: Love is the climate both people can survive in.

internal_repair_or_reject_routes.title: Jaldi Has No Definition
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.plain_concept: He says jaldi; she hears a full ceremony. The joke is acted through escalating getting-ready receipts.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.public_doorway: He said jaldi. Now define jaldi.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.proof_engine: One earring, outfit check, dupatta/hair, door waiting, Zuv's deadpan timer face.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.zuv_active_role: He becomes the straight-face witness and adjusts to real time without making her small.
internal_repair_or_reject_routes.payoff: Some people are not late. They are arriving with plot.

selector_note: Recommend Aachu Dictionary because it turns the report's strongest strategic lesson into a recurring format: private language made public, Hinglish contradiction, visible receipts, and active Zuv translation.
next_checkpoint: Creator selects A or B, rejects both, or supplies a raw moment. C and D are not selectable unless repaired in a separate pass.
